text:
Alex R.: Hey folks — dropped a quick prototype for aligning the time range picker with the heatmap scrubber and adding the sampling controls inline. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-range-align
Mira P.: Nice. First impression: the picker feels visually detached from the heatmap now. Can we try a soft connector (border shadow) rather than full shared background?
Devon K.: Agree with Mira. Also: if sampling control is in the picker dropdown, we need a clear affordance so users know it affects heatmap aggregation, not chart resolution.
Samir: Quick UX nit: the word "Sampling" is ambiguous. Suggest renaming to "Downsample window" or "Aggregation" with a short tooltip.
Tia L.: +1 on "Aggregation". Tooltip: "Controls how many raw events are grouped per heatmap bucket (impacts granularity & cost)."
Jon B.: From eng: putting the control in the dropdown is easiest, but keyboard focus order needs to be tested — dropdown opens, focus should land on time presets first, then aggregation slider.
Alex R.: Good call on focus order. Also trying two visual options: 1) inline compact row (small slider next to presets) 2) nested control in advanced panel. Which do we prefer?
Mira P.: For discoverability, option 1 wins. But we should collapse to an icon-only view at small widths.
Devon K.: Accessibility: ensure the slider has aria-valuetext like "Aggregation: 1 minute per bucket" and contrast on the label meets 4.5:1.
Samir: Colorblindness: heatmap palette needs a sequential palette that works for deuteranopia. I mocked one — will drop swatches in the figma file.
Tia L.: Copy tweak: instead of "Aggregation (higher = coarser)", try "Aggregation (larger value → coarser buckets, fewer data points)" — clearer for non-technical PMs.
Jon B.: Performance note: automatic re-binning on slider move is heavy. We should debounce updates to 300ms and show a skeleton shimmer while recalculating.
Alex R.: Good catch. Proposed CSS snippet for the connector shadow if we go that route:
```
.timepicker-connector {
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(8,12,20,0.06);
  border-radius: 8px;
}
```
Mira P.: Love the subtle shadow. Also consider the scrubbing interaction: when user drags heatmap scrubber, the timepicker should sync live and not close.
Devon K.: UX edge: if the picker is open and user uses keyboard to change range, the aggregation slider should not steal focus when its tooltip pops.
Samir: Suggestion for microinteraction: small badge on heatmap legend when aggregation != default, with tooltip "Aggregation applied — click to edit".
Tia L.: +1. That lets power users quickly jump in. Badge should be keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0).
Alex R.: Decision proposal: go with inline compact slider (option 1), connector shadow, debounce 300ms, rename to "Aggregation", badge on legend, and accessibility text as discussed. Any blockers?
Jon B.: No blockers. I'll add a short ticket to infra for debounce throttle and add an experiment flag to turn off live rebinding for big datasets.
Mira P.: I'll update the figma and add alt-color palette and motion specs (shimmer duration 350ms). Putting a small a11y checklist in the design file.
Devon K.: I'll schedule quick keyboard nav test with QA after the next build. Can someone add a note to the release checklist for the new tooltip copy?
Tia L.: I'll add copy to product notes and update help center blurb.
design-bot: New comment added to the Figma file by Mira P. — "updated palette + connector" :pushpin:
Alex R.: Thanks all. I'll prep the handoff + include the aria examples and code snippet in the dev ticket. :thumbsup:
